breadcrumb: Std 6 Social Science (English) — Geography Unit 2: Land and Oceans — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: The Earth is covered by water which occupies 71 percent and land that occupies 29 percent of the Earth's surface.

en.q: Land occupies about ______ of the Earth's surface.
en.explanation: Water covers 71 per cent and land 29 per cent.

questions.quote: Land classification - Sangam period: 1. Kurinji - Mountain and its environs 2. Mullai - Forest and its surroundings 3. Marutham - Agricultural land 4. Neithal - Sea and its environs 5. Palai - Desert region

en.q: In the Sangam land classification, 'Neithal' refers to ______.
en.explanation: Kurinji - mountain; Mullai - forest; Marutham - agricultural land; Neithal - sea; Palai - desert region.

ta.explanation: குறிஞ்சி - மலை; முல்லை - காடு; மருதம் - வயல்; நெய்தல் - கடல்; பாலை - வறண்ட நிலம்.

questions.quote: The Andes mountain in South America is the longest mountain range (7,000 km) in the world. Mt. Everest is the highest peak (8,848 m) in the world.

en.q: The longest mountain range in the world, about 7,000 km long, is the ______.
en.explanation: The Andes of South America are the longest range; Mt. Everest (8,848.86 m) is the highest peak.

ta.explanation: தென் அமெரிக்காவின் ஆண்டிஸ் மிக நீளமானது; எவரெஸ்ட் (8,848.86 மீ) மிக உயர்ந்த சிகரம்.

questions.quote: Tibetan Plateau is the highest plateau in the world. So, it is called as the 'Roof of the world'. The flat topped part of the plateau is called Tableland.

en.q: The flat-topped part of a plateau is called ______.
options: a narrow raised line of hills along a mountain
en.explanation: The flat topped part of the plateau is called tableland.

options: மலைத்தொடரின் ஓரம் உயர்ந்த குறுகிய குன்றுக் கோடு

questions.quote: The Deccan Plateau in peninsular India is of volcanic origin. The Dharmapuri Plateau, Coimbatore Plateau and Madurai Plateau are found in Tamil Nadu.

en.q: The Deccan Plateau in peninsular India is of ______ origin.
en.explanation: The Deccan Plateau is of volcanic origin.

ta.q: தீபகற்ப இந்தியாவிலுள்ள தக்காணப் பீடபூமி ______ தோற்றம் கொண்டது.

questions.quote: Plains are flat and relatively low-lying lands. Plains are usually less than 200 metre above sea level. Most plains are formed by rivers and their tributaries and distributaries.

en.q: Plains are usually less than ______ above sea level.
en.explanation: Plains are flat, low-lying lands, usually below 200 m.

ta.q: சமவெளிகள் பொதுவாகக் கடல்மட்டத்திலிருந்து ______ க்குக் குறைவான உயரத்தில் இருக்கும்.

questions.quote: Udhagamandalam, Kodaikanal, Kolli hills, Yercaud and Yelagiri are some of the hill stations found in Tamil Nadu.

en.q: Which of the following is NOT a hill station of Tamil Nadu?
en.explanation: Udhagamandalam, Kodaikanal, Kolli Hills, Yercaud and Yelagiri are hill stations in Tamil Nadu; Shimla is in Himachal Pradesh.

ta.explanation: உதகை, கொடைக்கானல், கொல்லிமலை, ஏற்காடு, ஏலகிரி தமிழ்நாட்டின் மலைவாழிடங்கள்; சிம்லா இமாச்சலப் பிரதேசத்தில் உள்ளது.

questions.quote: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on the Earth. It covers about one-third of the Earth's total area. The Mariana Trench is 10,994 m- and is located in the Pacific Ocean.

en.q: The deepest point of the Pacific Ocean (and the world) is the ______.
en.explanation: The Mariana Trench (10,994 m) is in the Pacific Ocean.

questions.quote: A chain of volcanoes is located around the Pacific Ocean called the Pacific Ring of Fire. The Spanish navigator Ferdinand Magellan named the ocean Pacific, meaning calm or tranquil.

en.q: The name 'Pacific', meaning calm or tranquil, was given to the ocean by ______.
en.explanation: The Spanish navigator Ferdinand Magellan named it Pacific.

questions.quote: The Atlantic Ocean is the second largest ocean on Earth. The shape of the Atlantic Ocean resembles the letter 'S'. The Strait of Gibraltar connects the Atlantic Ocean with the Mediterranean Sea.

en.q: The Strait of Gibraltar connects the Atlantic Ocean with the ______.
options: Arabian Sea off the western coast of India
en.explanation: The Atlantic is S-shaped and the Strait of Gibraltar links it to the Mediterranean Sea.

ta.q: ஜிப்ரால்டர் நீர்ச்சந்தி அட்லாண்டிக் பெருங்கடலை ______ உடன் இணைக்கிறது.
ta.explanation: அட்லாண்டிக் 'S' வடிவம் கொண்டது; ஜிப்ரால்டர் அதை மத்தியத் தரைக்கடலுடன் இணைக்கிறது.

questions.quote: The deepest point in the Atlantic Ocean is the Milwaukee Deep in the Puerto Rica Trench. It has a depth of about 8600 m-.

en.q: The deepest point of the Atlantic Ocean is the ______.
en.explanation: The Milwaukee Deep in the Puerto Rico Trench is about 8,600 m deep.

ta.explanation: புவெர்ட்டோ ரிகோ அகழியிலுள்ள மில்வாக்கி ஆழம் சுமார் 8,600 மீ.

questions.quote: The Southern Ocean surrounds the continent of Antarctica and is enclosed by the 60°S latitude. The deepest point in this ocean is South Sandwich Trench with a depth of 7,235 m-.

en.q: The Southern Ocean surrounds Antarctica and is enclosed by the ______ latitude.
en.explanation: The Southern Ocean lies within 60°S; its deepest point is the South Sandwich Trench (7,235 m).

ta.q: அண்டார்டிகாவைச் சூழ்ந்துள்ள தென் பெருங்கடல் ______ அட்சக்கோட்டால் எல்லையிடப்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: தென் பெருங்கடலின் ஆழமான பகுதி தென் சான்ட்விச் அகழி (7,235 மீ).

questions.quote: The Bering Strait connects the Pacific Ocean with the Arctic Ocean.

en.q: The Bering Strait connects the Pacific Ocean with the ______.
en.explanation: The Pacific's apex lies at the Bering Strait, connecting it to the Arctic Ocean.

ta.q: பேரிங் நீர்ச்சந்தி பசிபிக் பெருங்கடலை ______ உடன் இணைக்கிறது.
